title: Realtime Voice: Set Up a Spoken Conversation With Your AI Assistant | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Some people would rather talk than type. CrestApps for Orchard Core can hold a spoken conversation with an AI assistant, with a provider's own speech-to-speech model or with a cascaded realtime deployment that chains a speech-to-text, a chat and a text-to-speech deployment. This video sets one up in the admin.

In this video:
• How a spoken conversation works, with a speech-to-speech model or a cascade
• Adding a speech deployment: Speech to text, Realtime and Text to speech
• Creating a Cascaded Realtime deployment
• The site defaults for speech and realtime in Settings > Artificial Intelligence
• Setting a profile's Chat mode to Conversation, with its Conversation deployment and Voice
• Where the Start Conversation button appears in the chat, and tips

chapters.title: Turn it on for a profile
